The refuter was correct that the old M = 0 branch used undefined 0^0 and 0^(-r/p) expressions. The repaired proof now isolates M = 0 before any power manipulation and handles that case directly.
The refuter was correct that the old lower-bound step allowed epsilon >= M and therefore negative-base powers. The repaired proof now assumes 0 < epsilon < M before introducing (M - epsilon)^p.

The refuter's constant-path slit-plane counterexample stands. The definition now requires successive representatives to agree as germs at the joining point gamma(t_{j+1}), not merely at some remote overlap point.

The refuter was correct that uniqueness failed under the old chain notion. The current theorem now inherits uniqueness only from the repaired admissible continuation definition and the repaired chain-independence theorem.

The refuter was correct that Cont_gamma(xi_0) was ill-defined under the old chain notion. The current definition now rests on the repaired endpoint-agreement chain definition, so the terminal-germ symbol is well defined.

The refuter was correct that the old proof cited a false chain-independence theorem. The repaired proof now controls both segment coverage and the overlap neighborhoods where adjacent branches agree, so one fixed chain remains admissible for nearby alpha_t.

The refuter was correct that the quarter-turn discs were disjoint. The repaired example now uses the eighth-turn subdivision, where adjacent neighborhoods overlap and the branch values agree at each joining point.
The refuter was correct that the old L1 cited only the real geometric-series theorem. The repaired example now cites the published complex geometric-series item for the identity on |z| < 1.

The refuter was correct that the old L3 cited a re-expansion theorem that only starts from an existing power-series representation. The repaired theorem now uses the holomorphic Taylor-expansion theorem and the coefficient formula to obtain the larger-radius contradiction.

The refuter was correct that the old boundary-centered regrouping was unlicensed. The repaired proof now differentiates inside the unit disc, lets x approach 1 from below to bound the Taylor coefficients at 1, and only then controls the series at a real y > 1.
